pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away through contours that are too even and too closed. The hero has an unbroken dark line, doubled lines on rims and frames, and heavy grooves at tassels, grilles and hoops, where real cards let lit edges fade and vary line weight. A second tell is patches of fine stipple on surfaces that real cards keep smooth, such as apple skin, pot metal and leather. Backgrounds can also compete with the hero, with edges drawn as strongly as the subject's. The numbers rarely separate the pairs on their own; most calls come from line evenness and speckle in the maps, and confidence on p01, p04 and p05 is low.
